blocks.text: Places You Should Visit in Shillong

content.text: Don Bosco Museum is an ideal place to explore and witness the tribal culture and cultural history of Meghalaya. The displays in this museum includes a large collection of articles and artefacts that depicts the culture of the Northeast of India. This museum comprises seven floors where 17 Galleries are placed. The Don Bosco Museum also holds the title of being Asia’s largest museum that is known for its cultural richness.

Placed at a height of 315 feet, the Sweet Falls is one of the steepest yet breathtaking waterfalls of Shillong. People often visit this falls as a picnic spot to spend time with family and close ones amid the lush greenery, the mesmerizing sound of the waterfalls and the chirping birds.

The Sohpetbneng Peak is located at a height of 1343 m. This peak is linked with many mythological tales which is known among the locals. The Hynniewtrep Tribe, regards this peak as a spiritual and sacred place.

The Phan Nonglait Park, also known as the Lady Hydari Park, is one of Shillong’s gems. It is located at Barik Point, Shillong. Take a break and indulge in some outdoor activities amidst nature. When you enter the park, you will be welcomed by the adoring flowers, well-maintained lawns and benches where you can soak in the sun. Don’t miss the mini zoo and the museum attached to the park. The zoo is home to raptors, small mammals, antelopes and various other species. Also try out the street snack available at the entrance of the park.

A boat journey will lead you to this marvelous island. Located in the middle of Umiam Lake, the Lumpongdeng Island is an empty island where no one resides. You can go trekking and experience the view of the surrounding places from this island.

The travel time from Kaziranga National Park to Shillong is 5 hr 28 min (252.9 Km) via NH 27 and NH6. However, if you want to stop for tea-sipping, you can stop at Nongpoh and Morigaon . Stopping for a few minutes in each of these places will refresh your mood completely, so that you will be able to explore Kaziranga properly.
